sections.description: Charity Elemento is designed with a clean layout and includes essential features for building a charity or donation-focused website. It offers a structured homepage with sections for campaigns, featured content, team information, testimonials, and contact details. The theme supports responsive layouts, allowing pages to adjust across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. It also includes customizable colours, typography settings, navigation menus, and widget-ready areas for organising content. The theme works with the block editor and supports common page-building tools for creating custom page layouts. Users can add images, banners, galleries, buttons, and content sections without modifying core files. It includes options for logo upload, social media links, footer customization, and featured sliders where supported. Standard compatibility with plugins for contact forms, SEO, caching, and performance enhancements helps extend functionality. The code follows current development practices for easier maintenance and updates. Charity Elemento also supports translation-ready files and basic accessibility considerations, making it suitable for multilingual websites. Regular customization options through the Customizer allow changes to layouts, fonts, and colours while maintaining a consistent design across the site.
